correctness.rationale: Exact gradient derivative e2-x_i e1+x_i^2 bounds critical vectors to two values. The distinct-value power-sum equations force each nonzero multiplicity to be 1 modulo 3. Lucas mod-3 evaluation of choose(r,3) gives the indicator 1 modulo 9 class. Restricted cubic u a^3+v b^3 gives the full line versus signed-point dichotomy. Hessian block rank gives ordinary double points or a one-dimensional smooth gradient germ cut by a transverse cube, hence local Jacobian ring k[t]/(t^3). The one-dimensional case first appears at n=11; Serre R1+S2 proves normality. Exact independent F3 projective checker reproduces support for n4..11 and Hessian ranks n4..10, not used to infer all n.
